notes: Much faster answers. If Gemini is busy or slow to start, AI Hub now moves on to Claude within a few seconds instead of waiting for it to time out. With "Faster answers" on (Settings, on by default), it asks Claude too after 3 seconds and keeps whichever answers first. Grok and your Home Hub are never used that way. An AI that was busy recently gets skipped for a while. While you wait, the bubble shows what's happening, like "Asking Gemini…". A brief connection drop is retried once automatically.
